events.name: SCBA

sharedSteps.step: Begin in starting position — bottle on ground, recruit squatting or on knees.
sharedSteps.hint: Start low: bottle down, you squatting or kneeling.

sharedSteps.step: Turn the cylinder valve on fully; listen for low-pressure indicator + PASS activation; bypass valve fully shut off.
sharedSteps.hint: Valve full open, hear the alarm chirp, bypass closed.

sharedSteps.step: Position SCBA on back using the over-the-head method.
sharedSteps.hint: Over-the-head onto your back.

sharedSteps.step: Fasten and properly adjust straps.
sharedSteps.hint: Buckle and snug all straps.

sharedSteps.step: Don and secure face piece.
sharedSteps.hint: Face piece on and secured.

sharedSteps.step: Check the face piece for proper seal.
sharedSteps.hint: Confirm the seal before air.

sharedSteps.step: Connect mask-mounted regulator and start air flow.
sharedSteps.hint: Click in the regulator, get on air.

sharedSteps.step: Protective ensemble (except gloves) properly donned, NO skin exposed, collar fastened, chin strap secure under chin.
sharedSteps.hint: No skin, collar up, chin strap tight.
options: All met: no skin exposed, collar fastened, chin strap secure

sharedSteps.step: Proper face-piece seal — no air leaks when head turns/nods or with light tug on the regulator.
sharedSteps.hint: Turn, nod, tug — no leaks.
options: Sealed: no leaks on turn, nod, or regulator tug

sharedSteps.step: Complete all tasks within the 35-second limit, all safety procedures followed.
sharedSteps.hint: Under 35 seconds, safely.

events.rtoIntro: Ready for your SCBA evaluation? Bottle to face piece, in order. Miss a critical and you are done.
events.rtoModePrompt: How do you want to run this? DRILL to practice with no penalty, or GRADED for the timed badge run where a critical miss ends it.

events.name: Quick Attack — Plug Position

sharedSteps.step: Buckle up in the truck; ride around the block; wait for a complete stop (brake set) before moving.
sharedSteps.hint: Belted, full stop and brake set before you move.

sharedSteps.step: Exit the vehicle yelling, looking both ways.
sharedSteps.hint: Yell and look both ways getting off.

sharedSteps.step: Back of truck: RIGHT hand grabs the wrench, LEFT hand pulls the strap off so the hose is loose. Right hand grabs the Humat handle; turn right, grab the supply line with the left arm, let it fall on the left shoulder.
sharedSteps.hint: Right=wrench/Humat, left=strap and supply on left shoulder.

captain_side.step: Walk even with the hydrant — 7 steps out (or until you hear the hose fall); turn left, let the hose fall off the left shoulder, guide it around the hydrant; walk 5 steps past the hydrant.
captain_side.hint: 7 out, drop hose around hydrant, 5 past.

howto.captain_side: Pacing it out (7 steps then 5 past) keeps consistent slack so the supply line drops cleanly around the hydrant and the truck can keep rolling.

captain_side.step: Face the hydrant; make sure the hose is straight out of the Humat; yell + wave the truck to GO.
captain_side.hint: Hose straight from the Humat, wave the truck off.

howto.captain_side: A straight pull out of the Humat prevents binding, and the clear wave/yell tells the driver it is safe to lay out and go.

captain_side.step: When the coupling falls: go ~2/3 down the hose toward the hydrant, grab it, walk back around, throw it to ~2 o'clock away from the truck — keep a SAFETY LOOP around the hydrant.
captain_side.hint: 2/3 down, throw to 2 o'clock, keep the safety loop.

howto.captain_side: The safety loop around the hydrant absorbs the shock when the line charges so it cannot whip or pull free under pressure.

captain_side.step: Set the Humat outside your work space, to your right. Take the wrench, loosen the steamer cap; place + tighten the wrench on top of the hydrant; go back, hand-remove the steamer cap.
captain_side.hint: Humat to the right, break the steamer cap, hand it off.

howto.captain_side: Staging the Humat clear of your hands and breaking the cap loose with the wrench first lets you spin it off quickly by hand.

engineer_side.step: When even with the hydrant: go 5 steps out, turn, run back toward the hydrant until even again; then go 3 steps, turn, do the same.
engineer_side.hint: 5 out and back, then 3 out and back.

howto.engineer_side: Working the line out and back builds the slack you need on the engineer side so the supply can be flicked around the hydrant cleanly.

engineer_side.step: Put it down, face it, yell "GO GO GO."
engineer_side.hint: Set it, face the hydrant, yell GO GO GO.

howto.engineer_side: Facing the hydrant and calling the truck off signals the driver the lay is set and it is safe to pull.

engineer_side.step: Go about halfway; pick up the supply line with the LEFT hand, flick it up and around the hydrant; step with the LEFT foot, turn, do a DO-SI-DO (right to left) — face it, and while doing the do-si-do with the supply on the left hand, throw it out into the street.
engineer_side.hint: Left hand flick around, do-si-do, throw to the street.

howto.engineer_side: The do-si-do (right to left around the hydrant) sets the safety loop so the charged line cannot whip, while the left-hand throw clears slack into the street.

engineer_side.step: Place the Humat to your RIGHT-hand side, out of your workspace.
engineer_side.hint: Humat to the right, clear of your hands.

howto.engineer_side: Staging the Humat clear of your workspace keeps your hands free to work the steamer cap and connection.

commonTail.step: When the cap hits the ground: Humat in right hand onto the steamer grooves; left hand, go right of the hydrant, tighten the dog ears (~7 rotations right) until fully locked.
commonTail.hint: Humat on the grooves, ~7 turns right, fully locked.

commonTail.step: Go around the hydrant inside your safety loop; yell THREE things: (1) valve shut, (2) clamp on the supply line, (3) water coming.
commonTail.hint: Yell three: valve shut, clamp on, water coming.
options: Valve shut, clamp on supply line, water coming
Valve open, clamp off, hold water
Cap off, dog ears tight, truck go
Hydrant on, line charged, ready to fight fire

commonTail.step: Turn the hydrant on — all the way, until no rotations left.
commonTail.hint: Open the hydrant fully, no turns left.

commonTail.step: Check the supply line for kinks; address any.
commonTail.hint: Walk the line, clear any kinks.

commonTail.step: Back to the truck; place the wrench on the RIGHT side of the rear bumper.
commonTail.hint: Wrench on the right of the rear bumper.

commonTail.step: Open the bottle door; pull SCBA, turn fully on, over the head, buckle in; shut the door.
commonTail.hint: SCBA on full, over the head, buckled, door shut.

commonTail.step: Yell "what tool do you need?" → RTO assigns → open door, take tool, shut door.
commonTail.hint: Ask for the tool, grab it, shut the door.

commonTail.step: Run to your partner; check them off — no skin or strap showing on their mask.
commonTail.hint: Check partner: no skin, no strap on the mask.

commonTail.step: Don your own mask; gloves on, click in, on air.
commonTail.hint: Mask, gloves, click in, on air.

commonTail.step: Take tools, stand, yell "READY TO FIGHT FIRE."
commonTail.hint: Tools up, stand, call ready to fight fire.

events.rtoIntro: Plug position. Pick your side and work the hydrant clean. Lose the safety loop and the run is over.
events.rtoModePrompt: How do you want to run this? DRILL to practice with no penalty, or GRADED for the timed badge run where a critical miss ends it.

events.name: Quick Attack — Nozzle Position

sharedSteps.step: Seat-belted in the apparatus.
sharedSteps.hint: Belted before the truck moves.

howto.default: Always belted before the truck moves.

sharedSteps.step: Truck stops fully → unbuckle; getting off, look both ways and verbalize it.
sharedSteps.hint: Full stop, then look both ways out loud.

howto.default: Complete stop first; eyes and voice both ways.

sharedSteps.step: Back of truck (the clamp): pull up on the pack strap with RIGHT hand, slide the clamp out with LEFT.
sharedSteps.hint: Right lifts the strap, left slides the clamp out.

howto.default: Lifting the pack strap frees the clamp so the off hand can slide it out cleanly.

sharedSteps.step: Open the clamp; ask where your danger is → RTO points it out.
sharedSteps.hint: Open clamp, ask where the danger is.

howto.default: Confirming the hazard direction up front orients your clamp and hose lay toward the fire.

sharedSteps.step: Place clamp 2–3 ft behind first coupling, base toward the danger; hose centered → turn right 3½ times; foot closest to the truck on the clamp.
sharedSteps.hint: 2–3 ft back, base to danger, 3½ turns, foot on it.

howto.default: Seating the clamp behind the coupling with the base toward the fire holds the line so it can be broken and charged safely.

sharedSteps.step: Clamp on → verbalize "Clamp on." Back to truck, throw SCBA, close compartment door.
sharedSteps.hint: Call "Clamp on," then grab SCBA.

howto.default: Calling out the clamp confirms the line is secured before you leave it to don SCBA.

sharedSteps.step: Grab nozzle, bail closed → verbalize it. Cross it in front of chest, loop under the arm FARTHEST from the apparatus. Swim the excess line; stab the BIG loop, grab the SMALL loop. (Swim, Stab, Grab.)
sharedSteps.hint: Bail closed, cross chest, Swim-Stab-Grab.

howto.default: Crossing the nozzle and looping under the far arm sets up the Swim-Stab-Grab so you carry the working length without tangling.

sharedSteps.step: Running the line: hand + shoulder HIGH; feel tension → drop ONE loop (NOT both); keep running to tension on the second loop.
sharedSteps.hint: Shoulder high, drop ONE loop at tension.

howto.default: Dropping a single loop at tension feeds hose smoothly; dropping both at once piles slack and tangles the stretch.

sharedSteps.step: Line stretched → bail still closed, verbalize; call for water, foot on the line.
sharedSteps.hint: Bail closed, call water, foot on the line.

howto.default: Foot on the line holds it while it charges so the nozzle reaction cannot pull it out of position.

sharedSteps.step: Mask up.
sharedSteps.hint: Don the face piece.

howto.default: Mask up before the line is charged so you are ready to advance on air.

sharedSteps.step: Full PPE + line charged → straight stream ("right to fight"); bleed the line (open + close).
sharedSteps.hint: Full PPE, straight stream, bleed the line.

howto.default: Bleeding air and checking a straight stream confirms a solid charged line before you advance to fight fire.

options: Full PPE, no skin, line charged, straight stream, bled
Line not charged, stream on fog
Line not bled, no straight stream

sharedSteps.step: "Ready to fight fire."
sharedSteps.hint: Call ready to fight fire.

howto.default: The final callout signals you are on air, charged, and ready to make entry.

events.rtoIntro: Nozzle position. Swim, stab, grab — line stretched, foot on it, then water. Show me.
events.rtoModePrompt: How do you want to run this? DRILL to practice with no penalty, or GRADED for the timed badge run where a critical miss ends it.

events.name: Horizontal Standpipe — Front Seat Position

sharedSteps.step: SCBA ready (bottle full/on, straps ready).
sharedSteps.hint: Bottle full and on, straps ready.

sharedSteps.step: Seated and belted, radio in front pocket.
sharedSteps.hint: Belted, radio in the front pocket.

sharedSteps.step: Wait for complete stop.
sharedSteps.hint: Full stop before moving.

sharedSteps.step: Remove belt + look both ways.
sharedSteps.hint: Belt off, look both ways.

sharedSteps.step: Open SCBA cylinder valve fully + don + close compartment.
sharedSteps.hint: Valve full open, don, shut the door.

sharedSteps.step: Rear of truck, verbalize valves closed.
sharedSteps.hint: Call "Valves closed" at the rear.

sharedSteps.step: Pull stacked/strapped 2½" hose onto shoulder OPPOSITE the fire.
sharedSteps.hint: 2½" onto the shoulder away from the fire.

sharedSteps.step: Return for engineer's loop, extend, drop loop at tension.
sharedSteps.hint: Grab engineer's loop, extend, drop at tension.

sharedSteps.step: Remove velcro, flake until 200' extended.
sharedSteps.hint: Velcro off, flake out to 200 feet.

sharedSteps.step: Verbalize valves closed again.
sharedSteps.hint: Call "Valves closed" again.

sharedSteps.step: Protect gated wye by stepping on uncharged hose directly behind it — never straddle.
sharedSteps.hint: Foot behind the wye, never straddle.

sharedSteps.step: Take female coupling from nozzle position, stand on attack line, connect to gated wye.
sharedSteps.hint: Take female coupling, stand on line, connect to wye.

sharedSteps.step: Only after 2½" charged, remove foot.
sharedSteps.hint: Keep your foot on until the 2½" is charged.

sharedSteps.step: After second loop dropped, verbalize "WATER!" and open the gated wye valve charging the attack line.
sharedSteps.hint: Drop second loop, call WATER, open the wye.

sharedSteps.step: Proceed checking for kinks, then don SCBA face piece + regulator; check nozzle person ready.
sharedSteps.hint: Clear kinks, mask up, check the nozzle person.

events.rtoIntro: Front seat on the standpipe. Stretch it, protect that gated wye, and never straddle a line.
events.rtoModePrompt: How do you want to run this? DRILL to practice with no penalty, or GRADED for the timed badge run where a critical miss ends it.

events.name: Horizontal Standpipe — Nozzle Position

sharedSteps.step: SCBA ready.
sharedSteps.hint: Bottle on, straps ready.

sharedSteps.step: Seated, belted, radio stowed.
sharedSteps.hint: Belted with radio stowed.

sharedSteps.step: Wait for complete stop.
sharedSteps.hint: Full stop before moving.

sharedSteps.step: Look both ways.
sharedSteps.hint: Look both ways getting off.

sharedSteps.step: Remove + carry hose clamp on the latch side.
sharedSteps.hint: Carry the clamp latch-side.

sharedSteps.step: Position clamp 2–3' behind first coupling, more than 10' behind the tailboard.
sharedSteps.hint: 2–3' behind coupling, 10'+ behind tailboard.

sharedSteps.step: Apply the clamp.
sharedSteps.hint: Clamp the line.

sharedSteps.step: Foot on clamp base, latch side, "facing the danger" (hydrant facing fire), screw down tight.
sharedSteps.hint: Foot on base, face the danger, screw tight.

sharedSteps.step: Don SCBA + close compartment.
sharedSteps.hint: Don SCBA, shut the door.

sharedSteps.step: Butt-to-butt with apparatus at hose bed + fire location.
sharedSteps.hint: Butt-to-butt at the bed toward the fire.

sharedSteps.step: Nozzle crossed in front of chest; swim, stab, grab.
sharedSteps.hint: Cross chest, Swim-Stab-Grab.

sharedSteps.step: Verbalize bail closed.
sharedSteps.hint: Call "Bail closed."

sharedSteps.step: Clear hose out and away from the bed.
sharedSteps.hint: Pull hose clear of the bed.

sharedSteps.step: Clear attack line from the cross-lay bed.
sharedSteps.hint: Clear the attack line from the cross-lay.

sharedSteps.step: Wait for engineer to break line at the pigtail; take the female coupling.
sharedSteps.hint: Engineer breaks at pigtail, take the female.

sharedSteps.step: Proceed to the gated wye; do not drop loops.
sharedSteps.hint: Head to the wye, hold your loops.

sharedSteps.step: Approaching the wye, assure female coupling + firefighter on the same side.
sharedSteps.hint: Female coupling and firefighter same side.

sharedSteps.step: Hand coupling to firefighter at the wye; proceed to the fire.
sharedSteps.hint: Hand off coupling, advance to the fire.

sharedSteps.step: After loose hose passes the wye, drop the first loop at the right time.
sharedSteps.hint: Drop the first loop after hose passes the wye.

sharedSteps.step: Pull until the second loop tightens, then release from the elbow; extend remainder.
sharedSteps.hint: Second loop tight, release from elbow, extend.

sharedSteps.step: Verbalize bail closed.
sharedSteps.hint: Call "Bail closed."

sharedSteps.step: Place nozzle down + don SCBA face piece.
sharedSteps.hint: Nozzle down, mask up.

sharedSteps.step: Ready for IDLH — all PPE on, SCBA bottle fully open + straps secured.
sharedSteps.hint: PPE on, bottle full open, straps secure.
options: All PPE on, bottle fully open, straps secured

sharedSteps.step: No skin exposed / no air leaks.
sharedSteps.hint: No skin, no leaks, radio in breast pocket.
options: No skin exposed, no air leaks, radio in breast pocket

sharedSteps.step: Bleed excess air + open valve; check front seat ready.
sharedSteps.hint: Bleed air, open valve, check front seat.

events.rtoIntro: Nozzle on the standpipe. Clamp, stretch, IDLH-ready. Any skin showing and you fail.
events.rtoModePrompt: How do you want to run this? DRILL to practice with no penalty, or GRADED for the timed badge run where a critical miss ends it.

events.name: Roof Ops — Back Up / Probe Position

sharedSteps.step: Organize + collect equipment.
sharedSteps.hint: Gather and organize your gear.

sharedSteps.step: Power saws in a ready state before carrying up.
sharedSteps.hint: Saws ready before you carry them up.

sharedSteps.step: All PPE on, no skin exposed.
sharedSteps.hint: Full PPE, no skin showing.
options: All PPE on, no skin exposed

sharedSteps.step: Identify conditions approaching the structure; check eaves for truss dimension/spacing + sheeting.
sharedSteps.hint: Read conditions, check eaves for truss and sheeting.

sharedSteps.step: Go on air before climbing.
sharedSteps.hint: On air before you climb.

sharedSteps.step: Verbalize ladder techniques, secondary egress, charged line.
sharedSteps.hint: Call ladder technique, secondary egress, charged line.
options: Ladder technique, secondary egress, charged line
Valve shut, clamp on, water coming
PPE on, on air, ready to cut

sharedSteps.step: Access roof safely — pike pole hung on rungs next to the beam on the step side; hang the axe blade on a rung above the roof line, right side next to the beam; probe roof before stepping; NEVER step on rungs above the roof line.
sharedSteps.hint: Hang tools by the beam, probe first, never step above the roof line.

sharedSteps.step: Continue sounding the immediate area for the cut person.
sharedSteps.hint: Keep sounding the area for the cutter.

sharedSteps.step: Rest pike pole on the ladder; hold the ladder for the cut person; signal ascend.
sharedSteps.hint: Pike on the ladder, hold it, signal cutter up.

sharedSteps.step: Take the saw from the cut position.
sharedSteps.hint: Take the saw from the cutter.

sharedSteps.step: Sound the roof along the safest route (bearing walls).
sharedSteps.hint: Sound along bearing walls, safest route.

sharedSteps.step: Once the cut area is identified, sound 360° around it; mark an X.
sharedSteps.hint: Sound 360 around the cut, mark an X.

sharedSteps.step: Hand the pike pole to Operations Oversight; both hands on the cut person; no tools in hand.
sharedSteps.hint: Pass the pike, both hands on the cutter.

sharedSteps.step: After the vent hole is cut, receive the pike pole back.
sharedSteps.hint: Take the pike back after the cut.

sharedSteps.step: Situational awareness of foot placement + unsafe pike pole practices.
sharedSteps.hint: Watch foot placement and pike pole safety.

sharedSteps.step: Louvers on the correct side of the truss per wind; clear diving boards / excess roofing.
sharedSteps.hint: Louver to the right side per wind, clear diving boards.

sharedSteps.step: Push ceiling material down with the pike pole.
sharedSteps.hint: Punch the ceiling down with the pike.

sharedSteps.step: Probe back to the ladder; hang the pike pole on a rung on the opposite side.
sharedSteps.hint: Probe back, hang the pike opposite side.

sharedSteps.step: Take the saw + steady the ladder for the cut person.
sharedSteps.hint: Take the saw, steady the ladder for the cutter.

sharedSteps.step: Once the cut person is on the ground + butting the ladder, climb down with the axe, never stepping on rungs above the roof line.
sharedSteps.hint: Cutter butts the ladder, climb down, never above the roof line.

sharedSteps.step: Remove the pike pole from the ladder.
sharedSteps.hint: Pull the pike off the ladder.

events.rtoIntro: Probe position, vertical vent. Sound before you step and stay off the rungs above the roof line.
events.rtoModePrompt: How do you want to run this? DRILL to practice with no penalty, or GRADED for the timed badge run where a critical miss ends it.

events.name: Roof Ops — Cut Position

sharedSteps.step: Organize + collect equipment.
sharedSteps.hint: Gather and organize your gear.

sharedSteps.step: Power saws ready before carrying up.
sharedSteps.hint: Saws ready before you carry them up.

sharedSteps.step: All PPE on, no skin exposed.
sharedSteps.hint: Full PPE, no skin showing.
options: All PPE on, no skin exposed

sharedSteps.step: Identify conditions / eaves trusses + sheeting.
sharedSteps.hint: Read conditions, check eaves trusses and sheeting.

sharedSteps.step: Butt the ladder for the probe person ascending.
sharedSteps.hint: Butt the ladder for the probe person.

sharedSteps.step: Go on air before climbing.
sharedSteps.hint: On air before you climb.

sharedSteps.step: Never step on rungs above the roof line.
sharedSteps.hint: Never step above the roof line.

sharedSteps.step: Move tools to the roof safely; hand the saw to the probe person before stepping on the roof.
sharedSteps.hint: Pass the saw to the probe before stepping on the roof.

sharedSteps.step: Follow directly behind the probe person to the cut area.
sharedSteps.hint: Stay directly behind the probe person.

sharedSteps.step: Address the need for an inspection hole per conditions.
sharedSteps.hint: Call inspection hole if conditions require.

sharedSteps.step: Set the saw down + pull-start in a safe area (and when adjusting the saw).
sharedSteps.hint: Set down and pull-start the saw in a safe spot.

sharedSteps.step: Based on fire involvement, cut an adequately sized hole.
sharedSteps.hint: Size the hole to the fire involvement.

sharedSteps.step: Cut the vent hole with proper sequence + depth.
sharedSteps.hint: Proper cut sequence and depth.

sharedSteps.step: Situational awareness of foot placement / roof positions / probe person; maintain saw control; shut the saw down at the right time.
sharedSteps.hint: Mind footing, the probe, saw control; shut down on time.

sharedSteps.step: Directly follow the probe person back to the ladder.
sharedSteps.hint: Follow the probe person back to the ladder.

sharedSteps.step: Hand the saw to the probe person before stepping on the ladder; never step on a rung above the roof line.
sharedSteps.hint: Pass the saw before the ladder, never above the roof line.

sharedSteps.step: Carry the saw down; butt the ladder for the probe person; assist with tools.
sharedSteps.hint: Saw down, butt the ladder, help with tools.

events.rtoIntro: Cut position. Saw ready before you climb, control it on the roof, shut it down at the right time.
